title: Unveiling the nexus: exploring the relationship of e-satisfaction, e-trust, and online repurchase intentions among students in a developing country
core_idea: Investigate how e-trust and e-customer satisfaction relate to students' online repurchase intentions in Bangladesh, testing mediation by e-trust and e-satisfaction and moderation by prior online experience using a quantitative survey (N=415) with structural equation modeling and 2SLS for robustness.
tldr: Quantitative study examining the roles of e-trust, e-customer satisfaction, and prior online experience on students' online repurchase intentions in Bangladesh using SEM and 2SLS (survey of 415 students).
